name: data.gov.sg API
tagline: Singapore government open data for transport, environment, and the economy
description: Public REST APIs from Singapore's national open-data platform covering real-time transport, weather, environment, and economic datasets. Developers can query many endpoints without a key; some collections use CKAN-style datastore APIs and dataset-specific paths under api.data.gov.sg.

auth.details: Many real-time endpoints require no authentication. Dataset/datastore APIs may use CKAN resource IDs; confirm per-dataset docs for any key requirements.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public open data; no paid plans published for core APIs

use_cases: get 2-hour weather forecast for Singapore areas
query traffic images or transport datasets
pull open economic or population statistics by resource ID
